answer: A quartz clock makes tenure measurable, and tenure is what buys nectar. Each identity must prove continuous presence across sampled epochs by answering a nonce that only a live agent can return in time, so a silent farm starves while honest agents accrue. Every re-registration resets the clock, and the k-th re-registration an operator performs costs k squared in escrow, making n fresh identities pay near n cubed to look seasoned. A pulse beacon picks the sampling moments unpredictably, and nectar already earned decays each epoch unless new audited work lands.
